text: Amazing customer service. Walked through, in detail specials, helped us through our wine selection, and the food was top notch. Alex R. is by far one the best waiter in terms of his knowledge and recommendation.
They do delivery even late nights. Best Alligator Po boy in the area. Fried chicken is great. Portions are decently big. Food is Cheap too.
CLOSED.  Sadly, what was once a pretty decent Chinese restaurant, was apparently sold multiple times, and the worse for wear with each sale. Signs now say "Habanero's Steak and Wings".

We love the vault.  We are here once a week, sometimes more.  Great beer, but the pizzas are spectacular.  The pizza isn't a traditional pizza.  Artisanal in style.  The brown sugars Buffalo, the chili, and the sausage are our favorites.  A Buffalo cauliflower is a great way to kick off the evening.

There is a reason why the Eclectic is our favorite restaurant.  We have ordered carry out from a number of places recently and Eclectic is the only one whose food quality has not suffered. When we visit from Michigan each spring, Eclectic is our first choice for dining out. Service, friendly, excellent menu and quality. Thanks for being open to the people of Tucson during this trying time. Marilyn and Tom
First time visit, but won't be our last! Good quality food! Worth the price! My moms first time ever trying KBBQ and shes in love!! Alex and Austin were so sweet and friendly!! High recommend

We ordered food for takeout for about 25 people this week. We had a ton of allergies and Todd went out of his way to make sure everything was safe. Exceptional service and everyone loved the food! If your looking for a really good steak, this is the best place in Reno. I also enjoyed the salmon and the raspberry chicken salad. Thanks again Todd!

Upping this to a solid 4 out of 5. Really great restaurant, with a professional yet fun, ambiance, excellent salads, the wait staff is very pleasant and much more prompt this time. The food has improved, and the pleasant touches such as robust, fresh greens and perfectly cooked (yet still reasonable!) portions of the protein round out very good meals.

I get the sense that this is more of a lunch and happy hour type of restaurant, but I'm sure it fills up for dinner. People dress up a bit here; there are more casual options such as Turning Point in the same shopping center, but I prefer Harvest for its focus on farm-to-table, upscale yet not-at-all fussy cuisine.

GREAT SUSHI. GREAT SERVICE AND GREAT ATMOSPHERE 

I've been coming to Oishi for years and I can't believe I am just reviewing this place! Newtown is a little far from where I live but the drive is so worth it when I am in the mood for some Korean food or Sushi! 

First, the sushi: 

It's always so flipping FRESH! I never had sushi or sashimi here where it wasn't fresh. On top of that, they have tons of different sashimi/sushi options! I don't really eat uni from a lot of places but this place, I always get my uni, with quail egg and ikura with quail egg. 

Now moving on to the roll: 

I usually don't like getting rolls from sushi restaurants because they either put too much rice or it's flavorless. But I love their shrimp tempura supreme as well as their spider roll. I always get the right sushi to rice ratio and it always tastes so great! 

Finally Korean food: 

I love getting the Korean food here because it's pretty authentic without paying so much on galbi or Gopdol. Sometimes I come here just craving their gopdol! 

To sum it up, everything is so good here! from their sushi to their kitchen food and even their coconut ice cream with peanuts!! On top of that, the bathroom is always clean and the service is always awesome! I never had an issue of waiting for my server to get to my table! 

If you're in the mood for good sushi or Korean food, visit this place a bottle of your favorite wine of beer!!
Great experience. I ordered my meat at one window and sides at another. Service fast and courteous.

Had breakfast here a week ago and still thinking about the bacon special which was truly finger licking good.  Meal was wonderful.  Place was crazy busy so getting their app helped with a quick seating.  Only complaint was the hot chocolate.  It looked great but was too weak.  

Returned for another wonderful breakfast ended up getting the same meal and I was not disappointed!!

We have been dining at Masala Zone for about a year and have always had great meals and very good service.  The owner is usually there and very attentive and Robert the new manager is terrific.  

We love the shrimp and chicken dishes because they have always been  perfectly cooked and nicely spiced.  Pretty spicy, but not too hot and the shrimp or chicken is consistently cooked just the right amount vs many other places that overcook both of these dishes.

Drive thru is a disaster. Takes forever. I order online and that is taking forever too. Food is good but not worth the wait. I could have gone home and made my own chicken in the time it took to wait for this order

I had crab cakes for the first time in my life in New Orleans and guess what!!! It was a VEGAN CRAB CAKE PO BOY from Meal from the Heart. I've always hated seafood so I never felt it necessary to try a crab cake but I must say the vegan take on this was AMAZING! If you're in NOLA try this place out! You don't have to miss out on the NOLA experience just because you're vegan. They also have kombucha, vegan gumbo and everything that people THINK they are missing out on by going vegan. Follow me on IG @vegantastesgoodatl
Very poor service, did not get my order right talked to manager and she said we train them that way.

First time to this joint. Prob won't be my last either. Place is bomb! Nice portions for the price. Good tasting food. Service was just what ya need and ownership and management read well as the informative article of them displayed on the wall near the entrance, mentions!

Had my first experience with Guthrie's today and all I have to say is the chicken is delicious. Got the regular box which came with 4 tenders, fries, Cole slaw and Texas toast. Staff is super friendly and helpful, food came out quick. Will definitely be back!

Lucky Lobster never disappoints. I wish I would have taken pics of the whole table! Everything they serve is full of flavor. The Octopus Salad was to die for and there is a generous portion of seafood, grilled to perfection. The dressing was amazing as well, I think this might be my new go-to salad. For only $18 bucks I was very satisfied! Service is always great and I loved the one-man band. Nice atmosphere, I will be sure to take more food pics next time!

I don't know how this has such low reviews! This has been our go to for years! And the best part is delivery is even better when usually items are forgotten or wrong with other places - never here! Singapore noodles and house fried rice are the way to go!

What a cluster on Mother's Day!  I ordered before 5PM, was told it would be ready by 5:30 & arrivd to be told it wld be 30 more minutes!  I drove home, called at 6PM & was told 10 more min... I arrived at 6:15, waited in their crowded lobby with 10 more people until walking out in disgust at 6:30!

The online orders kept pouring in...  I guess they expect everyone to wait around.

The hysterical thing is I checked my VM today and they l/m last night at 8 PM!!!  3 hours after I ordered online!  What a joke...

This was my 1st go...  it will be my last

I love this restaurant! I think the entire concept of building your own sushi is great. If you basically only like cream cheese and shrimp that's all you have to put in your roll. It's probably a great place to take a beginning sushi eater. 

Prior to Covid we came here a few times for a quick sushi fix and always enjoyed it. During covid though is when I became a true fan and will continue to support this business because it's a true gem!!!! 

To offset the decline in sales during Covid this business launched take home sushi kits where they sent you home with everything you needed to learn how to make sushi. BRILLIANT IDEA! We ordered three kits during lock down! It was so much fun experimenting and building our own sushi. 

Support this business! They are doing everything thing they can to make lemonade out of the 2020 lemons we've all been getting. 

CHEERS!

Incredible experience. If you've been to Zahav and liked it, you have to try Laser Wolf. It's the same owner and also Israeli cuisine. My wife and I got lucky that somebody cancelled their dinner (big mistake) and we were able to get a reservation last minute. The restaurant is in what looks like an old warehouse in the middle of a fish town neighborhood; it was such a cool atmosphere and design. We had a beautiful night so they opened the garage door to allow fresh air, which made it even better! The decor and layout is very casual and welcoming. Slightly different from Zahav, which is somewhat fancy. 

The food is fantastic. They offer 12 different tapas that go along with hummus and pita. Some were spicy and some weren't, but they were all delicious. They have Babaganush and Kale Babaganush, which was different but very good. We both got meat and it was cooked exquisitely! Lamb and skirt steak to be exact. Highly recommend trying this place ASAP because it's impossible to get a reservation.

It was ok.  I must say the Smoked Tuna is AmAZING! But presentation is awful. U would think by the photo, I made some tuna at home and ate with regular saltine crackers.. I wanted so much more from service and the dishes. We ended up-ordering desserts to go and heading to get dinner somewhere else.. lol

Love this place second time being here with the love of my life and it doesn't disappoint. The ambiance and food is with the cost. I'd recommend this place to anyone on a getaway with their significant other. Bravo Romanza!

I recently moved to the area and was looking for a nice takeout place while we got settled. Tuk Tuk did not disappoint! We had quite a large order that was ready quicker than the website had warned. Everything was delicious; we had dumplings, fresh rolls, crab rangoon, fried rice entrees, pad woon sen, and doughnuts to top it all off! Many of the entrees could have any protein you'd like as well as any spice level. We had one hot entree and others mild; the mild ones were faint and the hot one had us begging for relief. We'll gladly be back for more!
Friendly-helpful & informative staff, coupled with the BEST burger my lips have ever tasted! Slam fucking dunk... we will be back!

Loved the atmosphere hate the customer service went in there and I felt like I was a ghost. I'm from California and. I was the outsider from the gate waited to get waited on for 10 min just walked up and left

I ordered the three roll special to be delivered and it was amazing! Avocado salad was on the money as well. Fast service and fresh food. Didn't try the raw stuff yet but judging from The care that was put into my order I will try it.

We went during lunch and had the special was a slice of pizza and salad it was super good . My husband likes Trident on Ina but I don't care for seafood so we will have to go there and then here for me. The service was good and the manager came over to make sure everything was good which is nice to see a manager do that and not just hide in the back or not helping so it was nice too see. We will be back again. Thank you for being open during this hard time.
Awesome find on a Lacrosse tournament weekend...Delicious food.  Cool room.   Highly recommended. Try one of the Bennys!

The NOLA airport is really disappointing in terms of amenities. They offer early flights and PJ's is the only option for coffee. I got a vanilla latte and a blueberry muffin (the only choices are blueberry, banana nut, or cinnamon rolls). The latte is close to undrinkable it's so bad. There's no vanilla--extra annoying because I confirmed with the barista. I get it's a monopoly, but decent coffee isn't that hard.

Totally worth the wait!! Get the shakshuka, you will not be disappointed!!! The wait time is very conservative, we got in like 40 mins earlier than predicted, and you can walk around the Gultch and see the murals while you wait!
Leaving this review from my toilet. Not so nice to me on the stomach this evening. Burgers were not fresh whatsoever. McDonald's for the loss tonight!
Food was disgusting, wait time was horrible, waitress was disrespectful. We waited 20 mins to get a refill on drinks. At the end we didn't eat anything.

National Doughnut Day!  Pre-ordered 2 dozen yesterday --- been to Nicola's several times and absolutely love the goodies.  Always fresh!  My favorite is the blueberry cake -- the blueberry flavor is so aromatic and throughout the entire doughnut.  So soft and keeps me wanting more.  Everyone in my office raved about them!  Thank you Nicola's for never skipping a beat and always providing great tasting goodness!  Recommend to call ahead to be guaranteed the ones you love --- she opens early (7AM) and begins to sell out fast.  Everyone just knows how good these are.  Best doughnut shop in the Bay Area!  If you haven't tried this place, you need to.

I was there this morning at 10 am. None of the people working were wearing masks or gloves. They are handling money, credit cards and food! The girl who was coming into work knew the person in line in front of me. Went right up to their car (NO Social Distancing)! I don't know who owns this store, but they really need to check on their staff!!

Went here for my birthday 12/11. Made reservations same day and very easy. Both of us had drinks which we thought to be excellent. The kale salad is must. And then we shared the scallops which were cooked and flavored well. Honestly that was more than enough food for us. It is pricey but I believe it to be worth the cost.

These tacos had a super weird coffee run to them which tasted like eating coffee grounds.  They have an odd selection of tacos, and lack the classic steak and pork street tacos. 

Wouldn't recommend

First time back in a few years. I should have gone elsewhere. We wanted to have a beer and told the server we were not ready to order. She came back 4 times so we placed an order the The Quad, substituting ranch dressing for blue cheese. The food arrived- chips were stale, no ranch, and no honey mustard. Told the server and she said to give her a minute. Before she returned the manager walks by so I explain the issues and fist thing out of her mouth is an excuse. 
They take out plate and bring it back with the correct dressings but same chips. 
5 minutes later the manager drops off new cheese and cheese but no apology. Haven't seen our server since and it's been 30 minutes.

This helens is not anywhere as near as good as the one on Jefferson. I asked for Jefferson Streets number and was told they aren't associated and I see why. Forgot part of my order and food tasted horrible would not recommend, just go to Jefferson 15 minutes away.
We come to eat here every time we're in New Orleans. Absolutely love this place. Food is great. There is always a wait, but def worth it.
The jalapeño crusted grouper is banging. Paired really well with the garlic mashed potatoes! And the conch appetizer is delicious as well. Our service was great!

Ok so I've decided to really start leaving reviews as I appreciate reviews left by patrons and I honestly read them.I had a few hours to kill and just moved to the Roxborough/Manyunk area and I love to patronize local businesses.I went into this tavern,the waitress-bartender was very nice and personable.I ordered mussels white,not the best I've ever had but not too bad,then I ordered chicken fingers how can you really go wrong with that.The fries and the chicken had a funky taste. I didnt send back nor did I complain.The waitress gave me the check and told me to take my time but she was leaving,I wanted to tip her so i gave her cash and i continued to sit at the table,after waiting 20-30min the young guy behind the bar never acknowledged me whatsoever so I got up with my check and paid.He did not say thank you,was everything ok or kiss my ass.I actually would have ordered something else for later on and maybe had another beer.I only gave 2 stars because the waitress was so nice and on top of things,rest assured I wont go back,too many places to choose from that I can spend my hard earned money.

Disappointed. Customer service at the host desk was great. Our server seemed like she hated her job. We sat on the patio and there was a bunch of flies. The salsa and chips were ok, chips didn't taste fresh, just warm. I ordered the short ribs eggs Benedict and it was good. The hot chicken taco was mediocre. Something didn't smell right with it, the veggies or sauce didn't smell fresh at all. Had a weird odor to it. My bf ordered some burrito in a bowl and it looked and tasted like a waste of $16-$17. The margarita was good. However it was around 12:45pm and they said lunch isn't allowed to be ordered til 4pm? Only brunch. Weird. Margarita was good but they didn't add the splash of OJ I asked for either. I had asked for hot sauce from the girl who dropped off our food and she literally disappeared. Never had that happened. They also add a 20% service charge but don't tell you personally from the server's mouth. Won't be back. There's too many other good AUTHENTIC places nearby. Oh also, they charge you $5.25 for CANNED modelos. I've never been to a restaurant that gives you anything but glass bottled ones.

Upon entering the establishment it has came to my attention of that the have not followed the ADA requirements for handicapped folk. But the food was good. I was feeling a little western today so I got the cowboy burger and my girlfriend got grilled cheese with tomato because it was the cheapest thing on the menu and she looks out for me #wifeygoals

I've only ever ordered takeout here but I can say I've never been disappointed and it's good quality for takeout sushi. Fresh sushi, good hot foods, not oily. They have a variety of asian cuisine so there's something for everyone ! 
Friendly delivery service from the restaurant directly. I pickup when I can because it'll save ~$10 off your bill.

Got some delivery during quarantine, and we were not disappointed. Tried the Sauced Eggplant, Adana Kebab, Falafel and Lahmacun - all very good! Everything showed an attention to detail that you don't see often enough. We'll order again, but I'm looking forward to dining in once we work past the COVID-19 pandemic!

We were told it would be a 1 hour wait on Valentine's Day at 4:30pm. We finally got seated at 6pm outside at a table where the heater was broken.  I asked to be moved inside and they said they would put us back on the waiting list and it would be another 20 minutes. I asked if we could order and move tables when one opened up. They asked the manager who said no. Really frustrating after waiting so long.

If you're looking for a pizza place come here immediately. Even if it's out if your way. You'll thank me. 

Fresh dough, wood fired, fresh ingredients - evident after just the first bite!
Quick and friendly service! 
Can't wait to visit again! 

Visit their website to check out what other locations their mobile trucks will be at!

Before heading to New Orleans I researched this restaurant.  It did not disappoint.  The service was absolutely top notch, our waiter was one of the best we've ever had, and the food was delicious.  We couldn't have asked for a better experience.  We went during happy hour and were able to have half price appetizers.  Highest recommendations on my end.  If I had to complain about anything it would be the salt was a bit heavy handed on everything.
My favorite Japanese restaurant experience so far. Thanks for all the details and all the knowledge. I loved this place and the staff working there, food and attention to detail was beyond perfect.

Not really being a fan of Pho (I'm definitely a ramen guy), I really enjoyed the Pho with medium rare brisket! (IIRC, the #42) I find most Pho to be overly sweet, but this was balanced nicely - a little sweet and a little salty. The portions were generous, price was reasonable and the servers were super friendly. It's no wonder the place was packed shortly after opening @11a

Went in last week and the hostess didn't even look up from her phone. We stood there and she acted like she didn't even work there. Very very poor front of the house experience. I've been coming here for years and that was really unacceptable. I ordered a cranberry and seltzer and she looked at me like I had two heads as well.

My rating is for the service. I have not had any issue with the food.

This review is solely for their Ramen/Udon menu. Not a big fan of their sushi. Anyways, this is my boyfriend and I's go-to ramen/udon spot! We're obsessed with their katsu udon - it's so good! I've also tried their spicy miso ramen and black garlic?? ramen which were also very delicious. But, I always go back to just ordering their katsu udon. Definitely recommend!
Was in Riverview and stumbled across this great restaurant!  I have been craving Pho and this definitely hit the spot, it was absolutely delicious

Curbside mobile is pointless. I could've gone thru the drive thru 3 times in the time it took to get my order from when I arrived. Sat in spot #6 for almost 15 mins never got my food. App said they would be right out w my order. Never got it so I left

We went here while in town for short time. Due to COVID there were few restaurants open. We like Mexican and chose this place based on the previous reviews. We were not impressed. Two of the five people in our party got food different than ordered and both were told that the menu was wrong. The child with us ordered a quesadilla and got one 5" tortilla folded in half. It was all okay, but nothing great. And it's really too pricey for what you get.

AUTHENTIC and DELICIOUS!!! I almost don't want to give this 5 stars because I wanna keep this secret all to myself. Had the chicken fajitas and the chicken was so juicy and flavorful and the homemade tortillas are amazing. My husband had 4 tacos and I tasted the chorizo and it was phenomenal. The chips and salsa are homemade as well and absolutely delicious. Definitely will be a regular place for us!
Have eaten there several times now and the food is consistently super fresh and prepared quickly. Delicious! One of my new favorite restaurants!

A great place for more than "Philly" food!

West Philly is booming!

And this is the place to grab a breakfast sandwich or grits and shrimp!

And a Hoagie won't cost $10's !!!

Loved my first visit and since then they have remodeled 

Tried the Buffalo Wing Platter on Saturday.

Sadly, I was not impressed.

Tossing the wings in the sauce in a hot pan ... would have made all the difference!

Don't get me wrong!

It's a great place!

They do great things!

I had the litmus test pepperoni which was not flavorful. Greasy is great if it comes with flavor, but not much beyond a filler slice. Small shop and great location for Ybor shopping and sightseeing but short on flavor. Okay for late night options but not full day flavor. This does not highlight or enhance the town by any means.

Cappy's has the best New York style pizza around this area. The pizzas are huge and always made to perfection. They also make an amazing Greek salad. I've come and just picked up a salad, that's how good they are. It's pretty small inside so we usually order carry out. They only have one phone line with no hold queue so if you are trying to order over the phone a lot of times you get a busy signal. It's worth calling back until you get through though.

I previously rated this restaurant a 2 star because of the service.    The owner and management team reached out to me to discuss the issues.   They showed a lot of integrity in making the situation right, they went above and beyond.    The service now matches the quality of their food.....5 Star

Absolutely LOVE Olio. The most authentic Italian food you can find in Santa Barbara. I've recently become a fan of their Bottega that they opened in their crudo bar during Covid - it's all incredible Italian focaccia panino sandwiches, arancini rice balls, pizza, delicious pastries, take out cocktails, etc etc anything you could ever think of they have. The nutella croissant was insane and I need to go back and order another immediately. The owners are the nicest people and explain all the dishes and history of them to me when I come in which adds a nice touch to it all. Highly recommend the main restaurant, pizzeria, and now the Bottega!

I was really going back and forth between 3-4 stars, but landed on 3 stars because the portion size was just so ridiculous even though there was good service and quality. You walk in and there's nothing flashy about Zama. There's the sushi bar up front and seating following that. I ordered the sushi and sashimi combo for $39 and some saki. First off, the Zama saki is absolutely wonderful with its fruity tones. Hot sake was pretty standard. 

I was most disappointed with the portion size of my fish. Everything seemed like baby portion. With that said, if you're hungry, there's a chance you will leave still hungry. I could not believe how small the sashimi and nigiri pieces were. Practically a joke. The only thing to really enjoy is that the fish was fresh.

Really wonderful menu and atmosphere, perfect for a date night and group dinners. We shared the momo to start, and had the chili chicken and phaktsee entrees. Everything was delicious but the phaktsee was especially good; we will definitely be back for more. The banana tempura dessert was perfect. We really enjoyed our first visit, and will be back soon!
Wow, what a fantastic restaurant. Everything about our experience here was perfect I highly recommend if you are looking for good Italian food

This has been my favorite place for years.  Unfortunately I was disappointed this time. My only issue is that they do not provide high chairs and they neglected to tell us until we were seated. I have been to far more expensive high end restaurants that provide high chairs. I get that some nice restaurants don't want children but this place could keep a high chair on hand in the event that people come to share the love of Cafe Poca Cosa with their families or friends as I did.

This is a staple in Soulard and a must visit!
Their back/outdoor area is the beat spot in the house hands down. 
They have a great menu and great bottomless mimosas!
I like to come here first to start the day and then work my way around Soûlard. 

It's a must see!

We count ourselves as very lucky that Tosco is operating during the Covid-19 crisis. Their food continues to be good, plentiful, and enjoyable. With things all messed up everywhere we are ordering out more than usual. They are ready and helpful. Pick-up is easy and they remain friendly and pleasant.

This is the hidden gem in the center of Pasco County, located right off the SR54 exit on Veterans Expressway. I don't live near here but I'm here three or four times a month and every time the service, the food, and the people are fantastic! Love their consistency in running a business. Stopped in today for a quick beer and ended up staying an hour, having appetizers and enjoying conversation with their bartender Dani. Her service was fantastic! I recommend Glory Days as the top go to WingPlace in Tampa Bay.
The portion size is great!  Food was served piping hot and fresh.  Free refills if you dine in.  Our first time here and it was delicious.  Excited to make this a regular eating place.

I absolutely love this place. The chicken gyro is the best I've ever had and I can't recommend it highly enough. It can get messy but it's beyond worth it. 

Tip: Park in the back if dining in; there's plenty.
Best pizza in Clearwater-Dunedin. Prices are very reasonable. Garlic knots are great.

Ordered curbside. I think I was forgotten because order was very late.  Thankfully my beverage was piping hot. Had the hummingbird 1/2 sweet and it was soo good!  Would order again. They also threw in a couple cookies. Sandwich was ok. Nothing outstanding. Could use more turkey- 2 little slices didn't do it for me, but the bread was good!

Great experience on our last day in Nashville. Xander was there by himself in a packed bar/restaurant on the 2nd floor and provided exceptional service in spite of that. Had an amazing attitude in the craziness of a busy Saturday afternoon   Will definitely be back because of him.

Some of the best food and service in Reno is tucked away in humble environs, evidenced by recently opened Senor Tequila's. Taking over from a previous restaurant in an industrial neighborhood, they've done a nice job refurbishing the place. Perfect for a Sunday family dinner after high exertion at a trampoline fun house.

Getting started, complimentary tortilla chips and pico de gallo were accompanied by warm chicharones. Just the things to accompany a rocks margarita ($7) garnished with blood orange and fresh mint, cazuela ($12), an earthenware crock filled with tequila, grapefruit soda, and fresh slices of grapefruit, lime, and orange, and La Llorona ($10), named after the tale of "the weeping woman" of Latin American folklore. Usually a take on a pisco sour, this expression involved tequila, mango, jalapeno, and chile/lime/salt on the rim. All were quite good, but the citrus/tequila loaded, clay booze bowl should be shared with a friend or two.

Queso fundido ($7) was next, with plenty of spicy chorizo atop a sea of stretchy, melted cheese. Great on both chips and fried pork skin. A dozen ostiones ($16) served with plenty of lemon and medium hot sauce were large, fresh, and briny. Further, a couple orders of ceviche ($7 ea) featured a pair of heavily laden tostadas on each plate, accompanied by half of a sliced avocado. The citrus-cured fish version was good, but on request my pulpo-loving grandson received a great mix of octopus, shrimp, and fish at no extra charge.

Cama

Definitely my favorite sushi spot in Santa Barbara. Food always seems to appear quickly, even during the peak busy times. And every server I've ever had here is perfectly attentive without being smothering. All in all I love this place and will always recommend.

I gotta admit, the name had me worried and the zero charm strip center location had me outright scared...but the pizza was damn solid (especially the chicken, pineapple and onion with bbq sauce) for an unreal price (~$10).

When you just want to get a non-chain pizza for a fraction of what snooty pizzerias charge these days, give Pizza Online Company a chance. It was the perfect antidote for my family's COVID-blues.

I came in with a large group after a conference this weekend and we had an amazing experience. 

The waiter and manager were prompt and helpful. Despite our large party, they were accommodating and things were quick and easy. 

I had a salad with buffalo chicken and bleu cheese dressing. It was really tasty and I can't wait to come back and try some other things on the menu! There was nothing I saw set the table that I didn't want to taste.  Also great options for vegetarian folks.
Consistently excellent, both food and total experience. The Eggplant Parmesan is incredible. Served in the cast iron pan, it is wonderfully crispy and sublime in taste!

I like this place a lot,  but I'm also pretty easy to satisfy. I also really like Mexican food,  a lot. With that, I'm pretty picky when it comes to local Mexican joints and this is my top 2. 

This is BYOB. The food is good, but I was basing my judgement off the fact that I was starving both times I ate here. I was super impressed the first time I ate here,  and satisfied the second time.  

You get house chips and salsa,  I've always ordered the chips and guac for more chips. Not that it's pricey, but seemed like most of the menu was 10 bucks. The food comes out quick, taste good, and fills you up. 

"the guac is amazing"
    -my wife

I also hear that breakfast is on point here,  and served through out the day. I could ask the waitress before I leave,  but I'll forget. Come and eat here
Just an update to confirm what you probably already knew - the tamales are as good as the tacos. So filling, so delicious, so affordable.

Seriously I don't know why this location doesn't have a higher rating.  The employees are always really nice, and it's clean.  There is typically a wait, but they are always busy!   Food is always fresh.  No complaints here!

I haven't been here for a while, but went in for a sit down medium pepperoni pizza with extra sauce. The young man said an hour! They had just opened too. Finally got the pizza it was way to well done, toppings were very skimpy and hardly any sauce much less the double sauce I ordered on it. It was horrible. I wont go here again!

This restaurant was full of personality. All of the food came up hot and delicious, will definitely be back when we come back to town. Emily was so fun, and I wish I could have spent the rest of the afternoon there! Great job Archie's!
Aubrey and Ryan are the best bartenders ever!!  Always have a blast, live down the street. Great food too. Great service!!

DO NOT USE ONLINE ORDER UNLESS YOU WANT YOUR MEAL WRONG!!! I ordered a cheeseburger with lettuce and the put mayo and pickles on it... WTF. If they cared for their customers then they would of gotten their order wrong.  Never getting food from here ever AGAIN.
Ordered through Door Dash. Half my food wasn't there and when my wife called up to get a response they lied about the order. Will never buy from them again. Thank god Door Dash refunded me
Good food , better then most ! Friendly staff :) would definitely recommend their carna Asada fries

The Good Dog burger is the best tasting burger ever. 
And the fries are so crispy and delicious with the aioli mayo sauce!

What a great use of space!! I loved the concept and feel of the restaurants in large industrial shipping containers. 

My boyfriend and I headed to the bar area towards the back and shortly afterwards, took out beers to hang out by the turf area with lots of seating and a great view of the water. 

It does get quite busy, so be prepared to wait to stake out a good spot. I would say it's dog and kid friendly! If you're going on a Sunday, it'd be perfect for football watching with their large outdoor TV in the turf area.

Love the atmosphere have eaten and had drinks here several times. Food is reasonable priced and tastey. However it was not a very busy evening on a weekday. Poor service, server had no knowledge of the menu or cared to check on us after getting our food. Completely messed up my order with my friend when splitting the check, did not mention the upcharges for items we got. Waited 15 minutes after food arrived and server was never to be seen after walking through the inside of the restaurant i just ordered a drink at the bar. Hate to make a review based on a bad server but I believe basic customer service is a requirement in the food industry having been a server myself

I went back again less than a week after my first visit craving more! This place really cooks their food supremely well. The chicken is perfectly tender, juicy and flavorful, the rice is light fluffy and delicious, the fresh naan bread is crazy good, and the item I'm destined to order every time is the chicken 65! It's so good, some of the tastiest chicken I've ever eaten! These folks want their customers to leave with full bellies and big smiles! My family loved everything too, I highly recommend this restaurant!

Visiting in Phila and went with some friends. Cool place.

Attentive staff and prompt service.
Ordered the avocado toast which had perhaps a teaspoon of avocado, (what?), side salad was delicious. 

It was good breakfast fare, not blown away. The avocado toast should have avocado
Great food, excellent server (Travis)!  Best selection of college football games around!  Favorite place to have dry rub wings!

I absolutely love this place and constantly beg my husband to take me! Great quality ingredients, great customer service, delicious drinks and delicious foods. I can't stop telling people about this place!

I have been here several times in the last month, I have become a cheerleader for the pretzels and beer cheese. Seriously so delicious, and the servers are always kind even though it's always insanely busy every time I go. They have an awesome beer selection which I'm always a fan of. Love kruegers!
If you like Southern style cooking, this is the place! Food is well prepared and you can choose between the buffet or the menu. Weekends are fairly crowded, so plan to wait a bit.

Worst place ever. A disgrace to Italian food & culture.. Very greasy and the eggplant rollatini were very wet.. soggy watery food I'm upset cause I've been waiting for this place to open.. total waste of time won't be back again..

wow - REALLY good burgers, and this was just take out, with the "fixings" on the side to do yourself! 

I can only imagine if I had it in the restaurant, cooked rare how I like, with some mayo.  Yes, a bit unhealthy, but that's how I fancy mine!  

Good side Caesar too.  Chips aren't my thing (I don't like potatoes; well, just sweet potatoes).  

I'd definitely make a special trip here in the future - yum!!!

So this location is within walking distance of my workplace.  I go semi-regularly.  I love the easy ordering, fast service, and yummy food.  Usually I go in after the rush.  Highly recommended.  

Unfortunately if you stop in around noon on a weekday beware.  Service goes down the tubes in the interest of getting the immense line processed.   They should be used to the downtown work rush.  At noon when the line gets long and winds around the tables and out the door they start rushing you though.  I mean have your order ready, don't ask for anything extra and be ready to pay!   It's tough to give great service like they normally do when it is that busy.  I get it.  What I do not get is when they run out of an ingredient.  Come on, your menu is only about 15 key ingredients.  In a business that has such a small menu of items that go into every meal option, how do you run out of an ingredient like pico de gallo at NOON on a Thursday?  It was either out or they were simply too busy and rushing the customers through to get more from the back.  Either way unacceptable.  I had to go to Trader Joes next door to pick up some of their pico de gallo so I could enjoy my bowl.  

Next time, I will skip it altogether at the weekday noon hour instead of that kind of experience again.

We took our whole softball team here and it was amazing! There are a lot of good food options like the tofu and eggplant :) Also, they have amazing Thai iced tea and make their own ice cream. Some of the members forgot things there and we came back the next day and they saved it for us! Truly an awesome restaurant! I recommend you choose to eat here!!

I lost track of time at the bar one Thursday afternoon wedged between a office group made up of portly men and three young girls they were all trying to bang, and then a young man and women who appeared to be on a tinder date trying to get a little sticky icky as well.  Shockingly I was still able to enjoy this establishment and its offerings. I had three or four Guinness' paired with the drunken mussels. The mussels came in a divine viscous sauce with chilis and curry aioli, the menu indicated it was served with fries, but came with two large pieces of buttered, toasted french bread.  Anyway, it was really good. On top of that the bar and the whole setup looked cool AF. The place was dim with candles being lit and placed everywhere like we were gonna contacted my dead uncle Stu. They lit the candles with a match, which was entertaining to watch someone take 2 hours to light a tray full a candles instead of using a long-reach lighter to do the job in 5 minutes, thats real commitment to their craft. The bartender is a young man, possibly boy, who brings a great attitude and was able to chat everyone up. I think they probably need to give him a few more shekels as he was working that personality hard for everyones enjoyment. Guinness were $8 a piece, but they are proper 20oz pints poured to perfection. I strongly recommend this place revise their tap beers, as they had a decent enough selection, but the wrong picks in my always right opinion. Overall, good food, excellent atmos

Upon calling, i should have guessed things were going to not turn out well when the staff. Who answered thought i was ordering " cheeseCAKES"... Upon receiving our food, delivery was timely however fiid was not. We ordered mozzarella sticks, ($7.99 for 5), and two REGULAR 
Sized chheSTEAKS, one chicken, one meat...the mozzsrella sticks were just your average stick, however, over priced- 8 bucks for 5? The marina along with then had a sour taste. To it, and when i reached in bag for a. Ketchup pack, there were none. I had specifically asked for ketchup when ordering. The cheesteak was also dry, with no ketchup on the sandwich either.  The sweet peppers requested were. HOT...
When i went for my chicken, (which was $13.99, btw) it was dry..but my specifically ordered condiments did come , one tiny cup If heinz bbq, and a small cup of hot sauce..id been charged $1.50 for each. Id also added a $5.00 tip to my extrodinarairly overpriced mediocre at best food, without being tolld there was already a $3.00 tip being charged to my order. So, after all was said and done, after my balance in my account wad off...my $43.00 order had suddenly turned into a $52.50 purchase. Ill be notifying new castle county police in the am, and calling this shady,peddler of shitty food and promtly ripping then a NEW ONE. 

.
This is our go to happy hour place. Inside seating if you want to hear the band. Outside seating if you want to talk. Great burger menu with a daily special. Great wings. Nice bar.

Every time I come here the food is always good. I haven't had a good review for a Chinese restaurant in a long time here in Indianapolis. This is my go to spot I tell everyone about it if they ask me where to go for Chinese food. I come at least 3 times a month.

We got in, and I thought maybe the service shortcomings mentioned in other reviews would be a fluke after they kindly got a high chair for my son. I was wrong. Once they saw we weren't getting drinks the service level fell. When our order was taken the waitress was nonchalant/disinterested. I got the halibut which was cooked decently, but was not overly memorable. What was memorable is I am writing this review while still at the restaurant waiting for my check, hoping my 2 year old won't get fussy, and I finished eating 10 minutes ago and my water glass has been empty for 25 minutes and no one seems to care.

Throughout the past 3 years I've seen countless restaurants move into this location and be unsuccessful. When the District Tap announced it was moving into the location we were thrilled.

It is the PERFECT location for all things sports. Whether it's watching a football game, grabbing some beers before a pacers game or finding a spot that can host a big group of friends this is your spot. The food is amazing and I've had so many delicious meals there. I love the beyond meat tacos, French onion soup, cauliflower wings and more. 

It's a higher class sports bar with great deals on drinks and such a fun atmosphere. It's right on the corner of Georgia Street which is a very popular location for fun events downtown. If you are in the downtown area and need some good food, want to catch a game or just grab some drinks it's your spot.

They catered our wedding last weekend. The food was fantastic. We chose eggplant bruschetta and asparagus cheese phyllo wraps for the appetizers. Then sausage and peppers and chicken piccata for entrees. The sides included chef salads, rolls, chicken and mushroom risotto with asparagus and broccoli raub. We had almost everyone come up to us to compliment the food. We took the leftovers back to the house for the after party and there was nothing left by the end it was so well received. Please note we ordered for 70 and had 63 come to the wedding so there was plenty. Sausage was tender. Everyone raved about the risotto. Even the broccoli raub was a hit. The 4 servers were attentive and went above and beyond with cleanup. They were professional and were on top of everything. I would def recommend them for any event.

Restaurant only 1/3 full inside (and lots of clear tables outside as well) and no one being seated for at least 20 minutes this Sunday morning at 9:45. Spoke with several of the other guests who had been waiting much longer and were very frustrated and also beginning to leave. Guessing major staffing shortages. Went to Panera instead.

I had such an incredible experience here at this restaurant.  The organic food, health conscious nutrient dense ingredients and kind friendly staff make it so easy for anyone to eat a plant based meal.

So much nourishment and positivity created at this location.  I always feel so grateful coming and going from Gangster Vegan Organics !!

Thanks
Bad service and food. They said there's crawfish until you sat down ended up with no crawfish

I've been twice now and I love this place. The service is excellent, the staff is very polite and attentive. Food is delicious and very affordable compared to anything else in the area.  I even got a cocktail I didn't like (my fault not theirs) and they let me send it back and get something else. I really appreciate their kindness.

COVID accommodations: The outdoor seating is ideal during covid because they have heaters outdoors. My friend and I sat outside December 7th and were completely comfortable! Staff was masked up and took caution.

There used to be a Qdoba on 23rd Street in Manhattan that I liked to frequent; however, it closed about eight years ago.  I hadn't been to one since, until I tried this place in Tampa International Airport.

I had a chicken quesadilla and it was very good. The price was low and the portions generous for an airport. 

One isssue: When I asked for sour cream in my quesadilla, I was told that I could have it on the side, which I thought was odd. (Moe's Southwest Grill lets you have sour cream inside the quesadilla.)

Although I like Moe's better than Qdoba, Qdoda is still good, and I like Qdoba better than Chipotle.
Not very knowledgeable employees. I asked about lower carb options and the man at the front did not have any answers. After researching what he did recommend it wasn't anywhere near low carb.

Overall very solid. The slaw was the delicious the pork belly was solid cut. However for me I could have use thicker glaze on my pork belly or a nice char on the pork to add some more depth to flavors. Overall tho it is solid food that is filling but still light. I did like the simplicity of the Poboys there. 7/10 for me would recommend

We went here for our anniversary. It's a small, quaint Thai place with several authentic options complemented by a handful of western foods. We had the curry puffs as an appetizer which, while pricey, were delicious and worth the cost. I had the red curry (excellent recommendation for waiter) and my SO had the ParAm (sp?) pork, and then we finished off with the EXCELLENT fried ice cream. One appetizer, one desert, two entrees and 20% tip for $60. Not bad! Will be back.

I thought this was absolutely awesome. Great price point and a healthy selection of food. Took it back to my hotel. Had been in Tampa a week or so ago to run a race and the staff at the Hilton suggested this location. Grateful I asked.
Quality and the taste of the food is not good at all. Me and my friends didn't like the taste. We're very disappointed. Will never ever order any food from this place again.

This is a fun and interesting experience. The coffee was good. The bacon was good. The toppings were generous. The price wasn't bad. Just be sure someone in your party knows how to cook!  Some  issues:  The hash browns took forever to cook (I think the griddle temperature is too low). We also watched a server bus a table by carefully cleaning the griddle- but never wiped down the table. This wasn't okay, even before Covid-19. The floors also need to be cleaner.

I have lived in Nashville for 12 years and this has remained my favorite restaurant...until my experience tonight. New location and I am assuming new management created a less than ideal dining experience. The music was so loud (we asked to be moved and were told they would just turn it down...never happened), the atmosphere gave me the feeling of "they are trying too hard", they lost the best part of Virago which was the rooftop dining experience, and the dress code is ridiculous. I recently had a male friend asked to leave for wearing shorts (it's 100 degrees outside) but tonight sat next to 2 men wearing shorts. My favorite item on the menu was removed and I am sad to say I won't return or recommend Virago ever again.  Disappointed and worried they may not survive in Nashville with so many amazing restaurants. MStreet please give Nashville it's old Virago back!

Excellent food. Lots of interesting menu options. Very nice outdoor seating. 
Inside seating is cafeteria-like, so I'm not a fan of eating inside this restaurant. Prices are a bit too high, so I won't go often.

This was once the premier place to enjoy Chinese food. Things have changed. The egg rolls were crispy but had no flavor at all. General Tso had good flavor but the batter was not fully cooked in spots. Fried rice was slightly darker white rice with only egg mixed in. Also lacking any flavor. Pretty much tasted like white rice. Very disappointed as I know what this place used to offer.  I do not recommend this based on what they served me. Many better options available in town.

Food and drink was good however their process for getting your order to you needs a lot of help. Several people after us got their food first and we had to ask several times about our order.  They have no idea who ordered what.  Fix that and I'd come back often.

Friend of ours told us about this place and he had excellent burgers. Not only do they have excellent burgers with awesome flavor. The service there was excellent very friendly people. If you like burgers this is an awesome place outstanding flavor outstanding service excellent fries we will be back just to try the wings next. There is at least three more burgers on that menu I want to try. I do recommend a rise and shine Burger though the flavor was awesome.
Very good portion sizes and great tasting food. The mushroom stroganoff was incredible. You won't be disappointed.

Their food is absolutely amazing, I've loved almost everything I've gotten from there. If there's anything to order, their Mac and cheese and Hawaiian wings are to die for!! And their desserts are unparalleled. However, I wouldn't order take out burgers from them if you like them more on the rare side since both times we got them they came a little over cooked. Again, everything about the meal was amazing except for that they seem to cook every burger all the way through no matter how rare it was ordered. Would still order again with chicken or salads and all the apps, they're amazing!!

I love this place! The food is delicious. The portions are enormous; the servers are nice and friendly, the prices are more than reasonable. It's an all-around win. 

The Texas Fajitas are delicious! The fajita quesadilla is huge and is super tasty, and the salsa is not one of those bland salsas; it's full of flavor. 10/10 would recommend.

Ordered both the Terakawa and Chicken Soyu, along with Tempura Shumai and Takoyaki. The broth and ingredients come separate to keep from overcooking the noodles which is great. Flavorful broth, and a strong showing from a well respected Ramen shop in the city. I would definitely return when I have a craving
Yummy meal with excellent service. Family run business with charm and pride.  Centrally located and nice outdoor dining.

It's a beer place, not a food place. But as a food place, go somewhere else. We decided to give this place a try for dinner take out due to the current crisis. Being this is a chain place, which I often avoid due to rigid guidelines set by the home office. 
I wanted to try their house root beer and sample their food menu. We ordered a couple pizzas and a sandwich and some naked wings. Being I'm not a fan of tomato sauce on pizza, I attempted to substitute pesto sauce, good luck with that... going back to rigid guidelines set by the home office, in a normal restaurant that would have been easy, but due to their rigid ordering system set up, substitutions cannot be done. I did suggest they just ask the kitchen to make the substitution but no such luck. They can only send orders to the kitchen via the computer to the kitchens computer, after all you were shouting distance to the kitchen, not that hard.
That alone should have clued me to the quality of their food and I did find out after getting home, the pizza was underdone, there was not enough bottom heat leaving a undercooked pizza, also the dough was like a undercooked cracker, not the fresh dough you would expect from a good pizza, the ingredients like the sausage and canadian bacon, pepperoni were pretty bland and by the pictures attached the bell peppers were tiny diced chunks, in otherwords, don't order their pizza.
The wings were pretty good.
Their house root beer will need some work, it left a sweet aftertastes in your

I'm not a Boba guru or anything, but I've had it a couple times to know what's good and what's not, and this is place DEFINITELY has some good boba. My boyfriend dragged me to a car meet that was conveniently at Bobacup, so I obviously made him get me some. The car meet was pretty lame but the boba def made up for it. It was super cute in the place, it was all cutesy and colorful- really gave me the boba vibe. I got the Mango Milk tea and it was sooooo good. Very happy with my choice. But what was disappointing was that the boba was 50 cents extra. Doesn't really make sense to me that a boba place would have you pay extra for the thing their business is named after...although through yelp I got the boba for free, which was great because I was a little annoyed about having to pay extra for it. All in all it tasted very good and I would recommend.

So my boyfriend and I went to this beautiful Cafe during a rainy day and during this COVID-19 thing. 

This was definitely something that made us super happy and warm inside. The ladies working were so sweet! The pastries were so fresh and flaky! My goodness, every layer came off so easily, it was so moist and fluffy inside. I was so happy with my purchases. I would definitely come back if i ever come back to Santa Barbara. This is worth a pitstop!
Amazing eat-in, but I waited over an hour for delivery, and I don't think my order went through. I love the food, though! If you go in, definitely get the mango lassi, and the veg korma!

I'm a local, I keep trying to like this place, but I am constantly disappointed. The drinks are horribly under poured and watery, and it's over priced for the food they serve. I went in with my husband had to send the drinks back twice and then just picked iced tea instead, we ordered oysters they were of poor quality and looked questionable to eat, then we ordered a steam pot of crab legs and clams we order these at every seafood place in the area and I've never been more disappointed, it had a small sad overcooked little cluster of crab legs, and the clams were those teeny tiny cheap ones that I've never seen served in a steam pot before. You would think for the waterfront location and the price we would be getting better quality seafood. We ended up sending our food back paid for our iced tea and left. The service, although the waitress was nice, was extremely slow so this took forever. We then went to rusty bellies at the docks, it has the same view, the steam pot had generous portions and good quality, and our drinks were not only amazing but pretty, captain Jack's doesn't jazz up their drinks, and believe it or not it was cheaper and better quality. I would suggest going there for seafood and water  view. I hope captain Jack's gets the feedback and gets better quality of seafood because it really is a cool place to hangout but I dont like feeling like I've been ripped off. Come on captain Jack's, step it up over there! We want to like you!

Nice place to stop in on while visiting New Orleans. The service was in need of some help, but given the amount of people out there, it was understandable. That was the only issue we encountered. The food was very good and the people are just kind. This is a place I would definitely stop in at when I visit again.

It is nice downtown Indy steakhouse with typical steakhouse saloon atmosphere, friendly and knowledgeable service, and serious steaks.  What I didn't expect was long and noteworthy wine list, covering all world wine regions, and well curated.  Good filet mignon with lobster, liked the sides too.  Interesting crab appetizer. Prices on a higher side, as expected.  All in all, pleasant dining experience.

The food is very good, but the Indian lady who is working over there is too rude and never smiles, and she's talking to you like you did something wrong or bad.. I hope she learn how to deal with customers..

I could not believe how good this place was...and they have the best prices I jave ever seen.  The flavors were good and everything tasted fresh.  THE EMPLOYEES WERE ALSO SWEET AND HELPFUL.  

One star gone for the sauces...they are more on the watery side...but hey, they got to save money somewhere to have unbeatable prices.  Would definitely recommend this place.  

OH A FEW OTHER PLUSES, they are open late and have a drive through.
Limited choice but classic delicious pizza.  Follows the Trenton tradition.  Restaurant is very basic we do take out.

Sunday morning I was looking for a suggestion on Yelp for breakfast. Saw the reviews for 417 Union and decided to dine there. This place has a lot of flavor. The decor documents historical events from WWII. The waiting area is small. But there is additional seating outside. I had a party of 3 and it took about 15 minutes to be seated. I ordered the Pancake Combo and my daughter ordered the waffle combo. All the food was delicious! It was served warm versus hot, but that was okay, considering the fast pace of the service. I will definitely go back.

They don't seem to care about people safety when asked about were a mask they shrugged their shoulders and didn't seem to give a blank this type of service to me seems very unacceptable they Seem to think everything is a joke or maybe they don't understand last time I go there

Love this place. It's bright and friendly, affordable and I had the best pasta Alfredo I've had in a while. It's with penne, which I loved. And the shrimp was amazing. I would definitely want to try the fish tacos.

I've heard so much hype about this place but honestly, I was not impressed. In my opinion, the prices were too expensive for the quality and taste of the food. I realize you're also paying for the atmosphere but it was so noisy at 2:00 in the afternoon that we had to yell to hear each other. $14 for soup, $16 for a cosmopolitan that was lacking in flavor and alcohol, plus $15 for a cake that was nothing impressive all amounted to a $50 lunch!!
Great dinner!  Had a wonderful meal. Only place that was bland was the mashed potatoes. All the rest was perfection.

We were excited to have a new small business to support but unfortunately will not be returning. We ordered two pizzas and waited about 45 minutes outside (as we were instructed). We went in to check on our order after 45 minutes and we were told "we just gave your pepperoni to someone else". Not much of an apology just "we will make another one". We waited (with our first pizza in hand getting cold) for another 10-15 minutes bringing our total wait time to an HOUR! We finally got home with our pizza and the crust is terribly chewy. We ordered the pepperoni and Tuggenmahpuddha which is suppose to be a curry chicken....it was more of a mayo and mustard sauce. Disgusting. I can't understand how this place has 5 stars. We won't be returning...we'll stick with Papa Johns...or frozen pizza.

Dined here several months ago and charged brunch for 7 to my credit card. When credit card statement was received the charged amount was greater than I signed for. Notified restaurant three times of discrepancy. Each time they said that they would refund the difference. No action by restaurant to date. Be careful at this place. I recommend that you take a picture of your signed credit card charge in case you have the same problem.

I love this place. We ordered two sandwiches, two cupcakes, and a coffee. The cupcakes were so moist and rich! Probably the best cupcake I've ever had. The sandwiches were pretty good too although I went with something simple. There's no doubt I'll be coming back to see more of Village Bakehouse

3 for $10 is a great deal. It's so much food for just $10. I've ordered Chili's takeout/delivery before and it's hit or miss but it's such a good deal, I still order from time to time.

I had chips and salsa, a Coke, and chicken fajitas that came with rice and black beans. This was my first time trying Chili's fajitas and they were ok. The chicken was tender and there were lots of peppers and onions. The black beans were the best thing on the plate - with tomatoes, onions, and peppers. I'm not a big rice fan, it tasted fine just crunchy. I love Chili's chips and salsa. The chips are thin and crispy and the salsa is on the thinner side which I prefer. I didn't receive the cheese, sour cream, and pick de gallo that is supposed to come with the fajitas but it was still pretty good without those.

My mom had the bacon burger with coleslaw and baked potato soup. The burger and soup got the seal of approval but she said she wished the cole slaw had more dressing or mayo.

Overall not bad for the price. I ordered delivery because of the quarantine but I like the self-pay kiosk on the table at Chili's. I feel like every restaurant should have those.
